metadata.title: Netherlands airfield footprint phases overlapping the Atlas period, 1936–1945
metadata.publisher: Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed (RCE), Netherlands
metadata.license: Public domain, as identified by the official Dutch open-data catalogue
cautions: Each feature is a dated footprint phase, not a unique airfield and not a unit deployment.
Start and end are calendar years only: do not invent month/day precision.
The historical-use field does not establish air-arm affiliation or unit strength.
A feature overlapping the Atlas period does not necessarily operate throughout WWII.
